0a3388e8.text:
Disperse information as you deem necessary.

Tirisfal Regional Command
Captain Melrose
Captain Vachon
Captain Perrine

Directives by the order of the Highlord.

Captain Perrine, further fortify your position at the southwest tower (as designated). Additional supplies will be dispatched at a later date. In the meantime, materiel should be obtainable from the surrounding farms. Also, further reconnaissance and information
0a3388e8.title: Scarlet Crusade Documents

3ff87589.text:
should be gathered about the organization of the $r in Brill.

Captain Vachon, there appears to be increased movement by the $r near the northern tower. This insurgence must be quickly and decisively dealt with.

Captain Melrose, there are concerns about the level of organization of the $r near the borders of the Plaguelands. A fresh group of men will be dispatched to your position in the coming weeks.

Glory under the Light
3ff87589.title: Scarlet Crusade Documents

7ca17b24.text:
Scourge have continued to slip through both the Bulwark and the eastern waystation, their numbers growing by the day. How such a failure in our defenses is allowed to persist is beyond my reckoning.

As noted in my previous reports, the paltry allotment of guards assigned to Brill is insufficient for what comes for us. It is not a matter of if we will be overrun, but when. And once Brill falls, it shall serve as the perfect staging ground to lay siege to the Undercity.

It is not my recommendation, but my demand that reinforcements be dispatched from their luxurious posts in the Undercity to defuse the situation while we still possess the opportunity.

--Deathguard Dillinger
7ca17b24.title: Dillinger's Report

85062c6e.text:
Executor Zygand,

It is my opinion that the Scourge we see further inland are not due to our defenses failing. I have witnessed our forces at the Bulwark and eastern waypoint for some time now, and it would take a veritable army to break through.

Rather, I suspect they are being newly created by some unseen enemy within our borders. I will continue to pull on this thread, in hopes that we may stop these occurrences at the source.

--Kristof
85062c6e.title: Kristof's Report

e57915c9.text:
<Impressively, there is a barely legible carving in the remaining skin of the apple.>

Apple yum yum. Me pick flowers now.
e57915c9.title: Gordo's Report

10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10666|5f4181c7.name: Gordo
10666|5f4181c7.text: Oh yeah. Us gots it right here.

11833|383e75cd.name: Rahauro
11833|383e75cd.text: Please, feel free to speak to me anytime, $N. You have served Magatha well. I am sure she will call upon you in the future.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

1495|54c6960c.name: Deathguard Linnea
1495|54c6960c.text: Greetings, $C. Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark. Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.

1496|54d7bdcd.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|54d7bdcd.text: Take it, then. It seems Zygand is too busy for the agonizing trip here to retrieve it himself.

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

1569|e2fc85be.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
1569|e2fc85be.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

1746|86caa6f1.name: Deathguard Cyrus
1746|86caa6f1.text: Fancy yourself a chef?  Head to the Undercity south of town for your training.  You can catch the elevators heading down at the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron.  Talk to one of those lumbering Undercity Guardians for further assistance once you arrive.

1746|d821d003.name: Deathguard Cyrus
1746|d821d003.text: Sorry friend, we don't have one of those here in Brill.  You'll have to head to the Undercity for that.  The Undercity is underneath the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south of Brill.  From the back of the ruins take the elevator down and then speak to one of the Undercity Guardians to find your way further.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

223|23e08fe6.name: Dan Golthas
223|23e08fe6.text: When I clawed my way out of the grave, I thought my family would welcome me with open arms. Instead, they drove me from the village, screaming in a language I could no longer understand.

2310|81663044.name: Jamie Nore
2310|81663044.text: I'm working on delicate matters of Horde intelligence. It would be best for us both if you did not disturb me.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

244808|3f8410df.name: Aramis Hammerhand
244808|3f8410df.text: Welcome back to the light, friend. Do you require training?

246143|0c0fbd1e.name: Frightened Paladin
246143|0c0fbd1e.text:
No! No, no, no! This can't be. I'd rather be dead than Forsaken! 

<The Frightened $C raises her weapon, preparing to attack!>

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

250686|3c4152a4.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
250686|3c4152a4.text: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

251001|379c835f.name: Deathguard Kristof
251001|379c835f.text:
Please do see that he reads it at once. I fear our Scourge problem has only just begun.

Come see me again in due time. I believe I have nearly uncovered something I could use a willing blade to help with.

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

271613|cd85d6bf.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|cd85d6bf.text:
<Othmar's head looks at you from nearby.>

What... You... Want...

Filthy... $r...

271613|f87677dc.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|f87677dc.text: <The body looks incomplete and appears to be awaiting a head.>

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3341|bdd68929.name: Gann Stonespire
3341|bdd68929.text:
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.

What can I do for you, $N?

3403|c189082e.name: Sian'tsu
3403|c189082e.text: Da spirits be strong wit you, mon. What kin dis troll do for ya?

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4605|1690954e.name: Basil Frye
4605|1690954e.text: I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.

4605|3a5f002e.name: Basil Frye
4605|3a5f002e.text: You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.

4611|ef68dfe2.name: Doctor Herbert Halsey
4611|ef68dfe2.text: You don't yet have the skill to study with me. Go talk to Doctor Martin Felben over there, or go up the ramp to the southeast and see Doctor Marsh. They are Forsaken who can give you the training you need.

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

5624|00d342d3.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|00d342d3.text: James Van Brunt in War Quarter on inner ring.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5690|c2467ddc.name: Clyde Kellen
5690|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

1535-progress.name: Brine
1535-progress.text:
I am just about prepared to send you on your other tasks. Have you filled the skin yet?

I know how protective the quilboar can be. Even such a small water source is a vast hoard of wealth to them. They have great feasts when even the slightest rain comes to the Barrens. Water is sacred to their kind because it is so scarce. Do you understand?
1535-progress.title: Call of Water

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

4542-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-progress.text: What do you want, $c? An urgent message - for me?
4542-progress.title: Message to Freewind Post

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5481-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
5481-progress.title: Gordo's Task

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

8-progress.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-progress.text:
Yes? Yes? What is it?

The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
8-progress.title: A Rogue's Deal

90902-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-accept.text:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen $c to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902-accept.title: Rediscovering the Light

90902-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-complete.text:
Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, $c.
90902-complete.title: Rediscovering the Light

91208-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-accept.text:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened $c who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
91208-accept.title: Coming to Terms

91209-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91209-accept.text:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a $c traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
91209-accept.title: Continue Your Training

91209-complete.name: Shari Stilwell
91209-complete.text:
Welcome aboard, $c. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, $c.
91209-complete.title: Continue Your Training

95216-complete.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-complete.text:
You killed it??

Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. I would have expected more from a fellow alchemist.

Get out of my sight!
95216-complete.title: The New Plague

96658-progress.name: William Pickman
96658-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96658-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97955-progress.name: Nurse Neela
97955-progress.text: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.
97955-progress.title: Camping 101: First Aid

98389-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-accept.text:
If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.
98389-accept.title: A Light in the Darkness

98601-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
98601-accept.text:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a $c like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601-accept.title: A Difficult Path

98601-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98601-complete.text: Your training can now begin in earnest, $c. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
98601-complete.title: A Difficult Path

99141-progress.name: Executor Zygand
99141-progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141-progress.title: Patience
